intuition: A window can be made uniform when its length minus its most frequent character count is at most k.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate substrings, count their characters, and check the minimum number of replacements needed.

optimal.approach: Use a sliding window with character counts and a running maximum frequency; shrink when the window needs more than k replacements.

edge_cases: With k equal to zero, only an existing repeated-character run can be used.
The running maximum frequency may be stale after shrinking; retaining it avoids rescans and still preserves the maximum window length.
